a.xlink:title: Shows the stops of the service with this id, or none when the id is empty or no service has it.
Lists the stops of the service again.
Seconds since midnight of an "hh:mm:ss" base time; 0 when the text is empty or not a time of day.
The table shows the stops again, so what depends on the timetable of the services is out of date.
The station visits of the route, building the section inventory first.
A chainage in kilometres as printf "%f" writes it, the form used in switch section ids.
